notes.title: Steam Verification, Fanart, and an Award!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Wanderers, [/h1]

[h2]✅We’re officially Steam Deck Verified✅ [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050902/53354c963ab4e24dc41c3e526e1966b7afaae2df.png[/img]

We’ve been compatible with Steam Deck since launch, but the official green check remained elusive.until now! While we firmly don’t believe in always chasing achievements and checks, this IS one that we hoped to get just so that folks knew that Wanderstop plays great on the go. 

I’m happy to share that, yes, we finally are Steam Deck verified as of today! So, if you’d like, share with your friends, and feel free to brew tea wherever life takes you (and your Steam Deck 😄🍵🫖) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050902/6f5ae9e9118f6f4733f38dde5febcf2c1366e2e3.png[/img]
[i]Did I take this picture as soon as I hear the news in my hotel at PAX East? Absolutely I did![/i]

[h2]🎨 Celebrating Community Fanart 🎨[/h2]

There are SO many pieces of fanart that we’d like to celebrate ~ here are a couple of pieces (in three different mediums) that we wanted to kick off with sharing! 👀We’ll be sure to share more in the future, so keep drawing, painting, and crafting ~ and be sure to tag us (we’re @ivyroadgames on all platforms) if you do!

First ever Wanderstop tattoo?! OMG (Credit: [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/wanderstop/comments/1k9fzty/tattoo/?rdt=41242]Zekkaan[/url])
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050902/f5e7a99b4c6862e802ee19ea56c86356720d117b.jpg[/img]

This duo are made for mischief (Credit: [url=https://bsky.app/profile/dicecatto.bsky.social/post/3lk2kwjkge22f]DiceCatto [/url])
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050902/bc26c6d59622c6a5717f2b9f836b8f8199c58f64.jpg[/img]

“You’re only as strong as your mind” (Credit: [url=https://bsky.app/profile/liminal-spaced-out.bsky.social/post/3liydj44gic2l]Liminal [/url])
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050902/1342b93fc3122acbd7a92bdab693bd35b2a19419.jpg[/img] 
 
A little tea and rest (Credit: [url=https://bsky.app/profile/neldacted.bsky.social/post/3ll2mq4te5k2d]Neldacted[/url]) 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050902/bde13f9628721447759a294806ecc8b7a94c2f23.gif[/img]

Again, we'll be sharing more in the future, so keep an eye out! 💗

[h2]✨ We won the WINGS Award at Gamescom LATAM ✨[/h2]

We shared the nomination during our last community update, and we’re proud to say that we won! If you’d like to see the video of the show (and our acceptance of the award) be sure to watch [url=https://www.youtube.com/live/MAbeJ0f9J1Y?feature=shared&t=11364 ]this VOD of their livestream[/url] ~

[h2]Until next time ~ 💛[/h2]

Hope you’re all having a lovely week! Take some time to sit, look at the sky, and brew some tea this weekend ^_^

Talk soon, 

🍵 The Ivy Road Team

notes.title: Wanderstop's first award nomination!!
notes.content:
[h1]📅 It’s Event Time 📅 [/h1]

The sun is shining which means it’s time to kick off game event season! 

[h2]LudoNarraCon 2025[/h2]

One of my personal favorites - LudoNarraCon - starts today (May 1st) and runs through May 5th! As a celebration of narrative games and their creators, it’s a great opportunity to pick up narrative-focused titles that you’ve been eyeing, listen to developers and panelists discuss writing and developing stories for games, AND add to your wishlist! 

Wanderstop is participating in LudoNarracon, and we’re excited to share that you can pick up the game for 20% off! Creative director, Davey Wreden, is also taking part in a fireside chat, discussing game development and his experiences in the industry over the years ~ be sure to visit the LNC event page to check out that talk on their livestream!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050902/e462f23001f084960dcdcb8a04eb880bb44724d9.png[/img]

Here’s the full list of titles participating: we’re in truly outstanding company! With all 50 titles, I don’t think you can really go wrong, but to help you get started, a couple of games I’d love to shout out and recommend you take a look at: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1675830/1000xRESIST/]1000xRESIST[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2756920/Keep_Driving/]Keep Driving[/url], and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3180070/No_Im_not_a_Human/]No, I’m Not a Human[/url]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050902/82198981108a1afffba4ad8d646aa157e8f3df17.jpg[/img]

[h2]Gamescom LATAM BIG Festival[/h2]

We’re also up for our first award! Whaaaat?! It’s absolutely wild (in the best way)! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050902/6850b9bbb2d057be427cb3607424c3185c959ca6.jpg[/img]

The BIG Festival at Gamescom LATAM is the biggest festival in Latin America since 2012, and they do awards each year celebrating the industry and games. This year, we’re nominated for the WINGS Award, celebrating teams made predominantly of marginalized genders in the games industry. Keep your fingers crossed for us, and watch the award ceremony on [url=https://www.youtube.com/@latamgamescom]their YouTube channel[/url] on Sunday, May 4, at 2 PM (GMT-3) -- this is about 7 am PST, so it’ll be a bit early if you’re in our neck of the woods, but the VOD will be up for whenever you'd like if you wanna sleep in!

[h1]👀 Meet Niblet and Elk 👀 [/h1]

Every game has plot points, environments, writing, and characters that change over development or are even cut from the game entirely. Just for a little behind-the-scenes fun, and because we know we’re not going to be adding them in in the future, we wanted to share a peek at two characters that never made it into the final game.

From [url=https://bsky.app/profile/moomanibe.bsky.social]Aura[/url], our lead animator: “These characters are Niblet and Elk, two folks who have fully functional character rigs but never ended up getting writing or animations. They were meant to be incidental characters, rather than have full plot lines.”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050902/8c7bb45e6d6b246b8df6a8d4178b4c31d6ffe2ee.png[/img]

Thanks to Aura, our lead animator, for sharing insights on these two! Perhaps, if you’re inspired, let me know what you think: what would be the teas they’d request from the shop? 💗

[h1]That’s it for now![/h1]

We’ll have more updates in the near future, but until then, keep drinking tea and finding time to take a moment of rest when you can!

💛 The Ivy Road Team

notes.title: March 25th Patch Notes + Pluffin Trailer BTS 🌷
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Wanderers, [/h1]

We’re incredibly overwhelmed with all of the kind words, fanart, and reactions we’ve seen, read, and heard over the last few weeks! Launch has been a whirlwind (not to mention last week most of the team also attended the Game Developers Conference in San Francisco!) and we’re excited to share what we’ve been up to in addition to celebrating the fact that the game is out.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050902/9636e56b5cf525f448256d7be1bd2556e0cb7eea.png[/img]

[h2]🍵 Patch Notes: March 25, 2025 🍵[/h2]

First things first! We wanted to be sure and share patch notes, as we’ve been hard at work taking care of the bugs you’ve been reporting (thank you!) and the feedback we’ve been seeing. 

Please continue to share any bugs and feedback with us [url=https://forms.gle/EvzLBSEG58Ly7iaDA]here[/url]: we look at all of them! 

To experience the version of the game with these fixes, please make sure you check that you’ve updated the game. You can see that by looking at the version in the upper right corner of the title screen (and you should see [b]Build #15460[/b]): 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050902/1f83ce918f0b23a966fa87e30230757ef040a413.png[/img]

Without further ado, our notes for this latest build out now on PC:

[list]
[*] [b]To help address the reports of motion sickness, we’ve adjusted the camera behavior and max FOV from the camera tilt![/b] It’ll be more sensitive to detecting player camera rotation in camera bias regions and defer to you as you play. We hope this helps! 

[*] [b]Fell asleep while playing? Weeds won’t take over anymore! [/b]We’ve set up an AFK Timer based on the last player movement. Please note that camera movement doesn’t count as movement - we’re basing this off of Alta! When you are AFK (aka Alta is still for 5 minutes OR if you’re sitting on the bench), weeds won’t grow and spread. 

[*] [b]Fixed various music and SFX bugs. [/b]For example, where background music can leak into Demon Hunter music events, the Cycle 1 song refusing to play when the radio is on, vocal volume polish, reverb song transition polish, and trinket sound effects when the game is paused. 

[*] [b]Fixed overlap issues with Xbox controller diagram on non-16:9 aspect ratios.[/b]

[*] [b]Allow players to rebind keys to AZERTY versions of the number row[/b]

[*] [b]Fixed a bug that caused some players to encounter a black screen whenever a cinematic was playing. [/b]

[*] [b]Lots of misc and small fixes and polish! [/b]

[/list]

[h2]💛 Behind-The-Scenes: The Pluffin Short 💛[/h2]

Right before launch, we made a trailer that highlighted a fresh perspective on the shop, as well as let our animators flex their talents! 

[previewyoutube=U9GX78winkk;full][/previewyoutube]

We wanted to take some time to share some behind-the-scenes insights about the making of the video – and ready to unpack the details with us are two of the five Ivy Road team members who worked on the trailer, Liz and Nat. 

A special shoutout to the full trailer team: Ana (Animator), Aura (Lead Animator, Rigging, FX), Daniel (SFX & Music), Nathalie (2D Art Director & Concept Artist), and Liz (Cinematics Lead, Animator).  


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050902/3be770c4c86cc198ac844b06c46f75be67a40f21.png[/img]
[i]The folks who brought the pluffin trailer to life![/i]

==============================================

[h3]What inspired the idea of doing a trailer from the puffin’s perspective? [/h3]

[b]Liz: [/b]Wanderstop is a game very much about Alta and her story. We felt our original reveal trailer already showcased things from her perspective perfectly, so we wanted to try a different way of seeing her. The Pluffins are a regular presence in the game and we wanted to explore things from their view as chilled out little birds that don’t have the worries of life and the world to wrestle with, contrasting with Alta’s own personal struggles.

[b]Nat: [/b]What Liz said above! The tone of the first trailer presented a dark side of the game, so we wanted to counterbalance that tone with some of the lighthearted elements present in the game too, to paint a full picture.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050902/fbd9eb0affd78d88d395d11099c810e96312c3bf.gif[/img]
[i]These lil dudes are full of mischief[/i]

[h3]What did you want to be sure to share and showcase? [/h3]

[b]Liz:[/b] I really wanted to show the Pluffins’ cat-like personalities in this short. As cute as they are, they get very mischievous and sometimes they feel like they want to annoy you specifically. (While recording a shot, one actual in-game Pluffin ran in and interrupted it!) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050902/af7a084fcc95f2ebb26bd8c26dcb7e3f69c0ff2c.gif[/img]
[i]Blooper time![/i]

[b]Nat: [/b]I wanted to show the world in this more casual, baby-cam view. Kind of like the feeling of being a 5-year old pleasantly playing a game while parents have an argument in the background.

[h3]In a nutshell, how did the trailer creation process work (e.g. brainstorm, storyboard, blocking, etc)? [/h3]

[b]Liz:[/b] It was collaboration all the way through! Jenny approached us with the premise for the trailer, Nathalie did 2D storyboards mapping out the short, I interpreted the storyboards into in-engine shots adjusting things for runtime, and laying down the blocking poses for me and the animation team to work on. Once all the animation was done, Ana handled final renders and compositions, and Daniel followed up with the amazing sounds and music you hear in it. 

[b]Nat: [/b]What Liz said above! We also had come together as a group to define a script idea together, before I started doing any storyboard thumbnails.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050902/6923cc6d197a3980a9edc0308290acc854dac9c6.png[/img]
[i]Some of Nat's storyboard examples[/i]

[h3]Any challenges come up when animating? [/h3]

[b]Liz: [/b]The biggest challenge for me was working with the tea machine while filming. I wanted to make sure the continuity was good; if I did any action out of sync with the animated cameras or otherwise ruined the shot I’d have to dump out the tea, make a new batch, and start from the top.

[b]Nat:[/b] During the Alta-Pluffin stand off, there was originally a shot of Boro watching excitedly from behind a door that had to be cut for time. It was an amazing shot.

[h3]Did anything come especially easily OR that you were very excited to create?[/h3]

[b]Liz: [/b]I was particularly excited to work on the shots where we’d mix hand-made animations and acted out gameplay at the same time. Controlling Alta while in the perspective of the movie camera and having to act in conjunction with the hand animated Pluffin was really fun. It felt a lot like making a machinima, making the footage in real-time.

[h3]Are there any details you want to highlight (e.g. things players should pay attention to? Anything you want to brag about?)[/h3]

[b]Liz: [/b]I feel really good about the bespoke animations Aura, Ana, and I did! My favorite shot to animate was the Alta versus Pluffin bit where they swipe for the tea cup like in an old western duel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050902/d22f4f8ab56ec0d90ef38ac394a2626676979e6e.gif[/img]
[i]Fastest steeper in the West[/i]

[h3]What do you hope players get out of Wanderstop when they play? [/h3]

[b]Liz:[/b] I hope people will love the audio and visual treat the team has made for them, and enjoy how our characters come to life through our animations.

[b]Nat:[/b] I hope players are able to use this game as a tool to help themselves through their own struggles. Maybe the game is an epiphany for them, or a toy that helps them manage stress throughout the week.

==========================================

A HUGE thank you to Liz, Nat, and the whole trailer team for making such a delightful short dedicated to a day in the life of a pluffin. And thank YOU for reading and supporting Wanderstop! 

As always, you can find us on [url=https://bsky.app/profile/ivyroadgames.bsky.social]Bluesky [/url]and [url=https://www.youtube.com/@ivyroadgames]YouTube[/url]. 

Cheers, 

🍵 The Ivy Road Team

notes.title: Wanderstop is out now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050902/15e64886bb24d4de906c41b553a21ba4f92e1ec0.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hello Wanderers, [/h1]

The tea is ready; the shop is open: the question remains: is Alta ready to heal? Fortunately, you can now dive into Wanderstop to see!

[h2]🍵 Wanderstop is out now on Steam, PlayStation 5, and Xbox! 🍵[/h2]

Thank you to everyone who has supported the team throughout development and leading into launch. If you watched our trailers, wishlisted the game, played the demo, created fanart, or simply just looked forward to experiencing Alta’s journey, we appreciate you! 

[previewyoutube=U9GX78winkk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]🎮 Ritual & Repetition: Designing Wanderstop 🎮[/h2]

We thought it would be fun to have members of the team shed some light on our goals and motivations with Wanderstop. First up? We have the wonderful Steve – Lead Designer at Ivy Road – here to talk about the design of the game. 

[previewyoutube=ptaA66BDPjA;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Here's an excerpt from the conversation~ [/b]

[i]Wanderstop is a slightly different experience than most cozy games. This isn't about deep systemic depth or the same kind of repetitive challenge put together by more traditional farming sims. Wanderstop is focused on its narrative experience and building out mechanics that support that through ritual, repetition, and aggregated meaning.[/i]

[h2]💛 Share your experience 💛[/h2]

One of the things we’re looking forward to the most is seeing what YOU make of Wanderstop as you play!

A common adage in game development – and most art forms – is that the final part of creating something is when the audience can take it, engage with it, and make it their own: we’ve infused our own stories and experiences into Wanderstop, and it’s time for you all to truly complete Alta’s journey by going through it yourselves. 

We’ll be watching streams, enjoying videos, and reading comments, so please: let us know what you think, if you’ve connected with the game and its themes! [b]The best way to help? Leave a Steam review sharing your thoughts! [/b]

You can also find us on [url=https://bsky.app/profile/ivyroadgames.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url] and [url=https://youtube.com/@ivyroadgames]YouTube[/url]. 

[b]Also! If you happen to have any bugs to report, please let us know [url=https://forms.gle/9EwZ66mdWL65tm1G9]here[/url]![/b] We'll be keeping an eye on that form, and it'll be the best place to let us know if anything seems to be going awry. 

[h2]🎧 Relaxing beats to sip tea to 🎧[/h2]

And, if you can’t get enough of Wanderstop, allow the sounds to carry you through the day ~ whether sipping tea (or hard at work), [url=https://audiosalad.ffm.to/ce1i047xg1]the OST by C418[/url] is a marvel with over 80 tracks to enjoy!

[h3]Thanks again, and talk soon! Hope you all enjoy the game (and, hopefully, a bit of tea) ~[/h3]


🍵 The Ivy Road Team

notes.title: Play Wanderstop’s NextFest Demo now!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Wanderers, [/h1]

Good tea takes time to brew, and you’ve all been very patient…. which is why we’re extra excited to share that the demo for Wanderstop is now available for you to play!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050902/222d398f2995e2dc815b4c814af25a0d97ead896.gif[/img]


[h2]🍵 Play the Steam NextFest Demo now! 🍵 [/h2]

We officially announced our demo’s availability during the Annapurna Interactive Showcase (more on that below)! As you hop in to enjoy the start of Wanderstop, we hope that you keep a couple things in mind:

[b]🐛 See a bug? Let us know! [/b]We’ll be keeping an eye on Steam forums and social channels, but the best way for us to keep track is if you fill out [url=https://forms.gle/TmufPNFQS9uuE5gb6]this bug report form[/url]. 


[u][b]💾Demo saves will NOT carry over into the final game.[/b][/u]We anticipate the demo taking you about 30-45 minutes to complete, and it’s intended to be a small taste of the wider tale you’ll experience in the game. 

[b]📌 Please tag us if you create content![/b] We’re @ivyroadgames across [url=https://bsky.app/profile/ivyroadgames.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/ivyroadgames/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://youtube.com/@ivyroadgames]YouTube[/url], and [url=https://tiktok.com/@ivyroadgames]TikTok[/url], and would love to see what you think. 

[b]💌 Enjoy the experience![/b] We’ve put a lot of love and energy into this game, and we hope you enjoy diving in, reflecting on the story, listening to the music, and feasting your eyes on this magical clearing in the woods. Thank you for giving it a try!

[h2]🎬 A New Trailer + the Annapurna Interactive Showcase[/h2]

Not only did the showcase give two of our team members – Davey and Patrick – the opportunity to share a bit more about the game, but it featured a brand new trailer from Ivy Road.

This trailer offered a fresh perspective on life at the tea shop, from a (perhaps) unlikely source. We sincerely hope you enjoy it!

[previewyoutube=OH9c4TJhAyw;full][/previewyoutube]

If you’d like a behind-the-scenes glimpse at the team’s process for this trailer, be sure to keep an eye out for our Xbox Wire post (coming soon!) And that’s right: We also announced that in addition to Steam and PlayStation 5, Wanderstop is coming to Xbox Series X | S! The game will be available on all three platforms on March 11, 2025. 

In addition to the Wanderstop news, the showcase included a bevvy of incredible titles coming from Annapurna and their latest updates. Make sure you check out the full broadcast here:

[previewyoutube=5XTSFLFV7e8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Thanks for all of your support 💛[/h2]

Be sure to follow us here on Steam (or find us on Bluesky!) to stay in the loop. March 11th is right around the corner, and we hope you’re ready to find out if you’re able to slow down, reflect, and savor some tea. 

Talk soon, 

The Ivy Road team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050902/3f0b063c5e7accd7debd7306759ded51614d9b6c.png[/img]

notes.title: Wanderstop’s First Music Reveal
notes.content:
Hello Wanderers, 

Our final update for the year is one that, ideally, includes headphones, calming breaths, and perhaps a cup of your favorite tea. We were invited to be a part of the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DDx88FC2ak8]Day of the Devs Pre-Show[/url], and decided it would be a great opportunity to reveal – for the first time ever – some sounds of Wanderstop.

Daniel – who you may already know as C418 – is the composer for our game. In Wanderstop, he has crafted a procedural system that allows the music to loosely follow the actions of the player, dynamically adjusting as you explore the wonders of the shop and introduce yourself to travelers who wander across your path. 

[h1]🎵 Wanderstop’s First Music Reveal 🎵[/h1]

For the Day of the Devs pre-show, we wanted to capture a bit of what it’ll feel like if you set the controller down and let the game run. We hope you enjoy this taste of the world and its music, and sincerely hope it brings a bit of peace and relaxation to your day. 

[previewyoutube=Pj2IB-_LwoQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Listen now on YouTube, Bandcamp, and Spotify 🎧[/h2]

If you hope to have this on repeat, we’ve got you! In addition to the YouTube link above where you can enjoy the visuals from the game, you can also find this track at all the links below:

[b]Various streaming services[/b] - [url=https://audiosalad.ffm.to/wander]https://audiosalad.ffm.to/wander[/url]
[b]Bandcamp[/b] - [url=https://c418.bandcamp.com/track/wanderstop]https://c418.bandcamp.com/track/wanderstop[/url]

[h1]See you in 2025💛[/h1]

That’s it for this year in terms of big announcements! In case you missed it, [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S91LuHPBEU8]we revealed our release date[/url] at the PC Gaming Show’s Most Wanted last week: you’ll be able to pick up Wanderstop on March 11, 2025 on Steam and PlayStation.  

March will be here before we know it, and we’ve got a few additional announcements up our sleeves before then, so be sure to follow us here and on [url=https://bsky.app/profile/ivyroadgames.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url] for all the news, and we hope you all have a wonderful and safe holiday season!


Talk soon, 

🍵 The Ivy Road Team

notes.title: Wanderstop has a release date!
notes.content:
Hello Wanderers, 

The year has truly flown by! We’re overjoyed to be able to share some exciting news to kick off December (and the start of 2024’s gaming showcase bonanza):

[h1]📅 We have a release date 📅 [/h1]
[h2]You can pick up Wanderstop on March 11, 2025 on PlayStation 5 and Steam.[/h2]

If you’d like to see more gameplay, check out our release date announcement trailer. It was originally featured on PC Gaming Show: Most Wanted and includes our creative director, Davey Wreden, reflecting on the personal origins of the game’s narrative. 

[previewyoutube=S91LuHPBEU8;full][/previewyoutube]

The fun isn’t over with the PC Gaming Show: Most Wanted! We have more Wanderstop goodness coming your way before the year is out during the 2024 Day of the Devs broadcast, which airs at 9 am on December 11th. Be sure to follow us here on Steam (or find us on Bluesky!) to stay in the loop. 

[h1]Thanks for all of your support 💛[/h1]

We look forward to seeing you in the new year with even more Wanderstop news and updates ~

Talk soon, 

🍵 The Ivy Road Team


And now, for a moment of pluffin appreciation:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050902/46147d7de23a6b8bbb9f0afba83f3d5e63fb637b.gif[/img]
